newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee firm but off highs, cocoa, sugar mixe.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee firm but off highs, cocoa, sugar mixe.

text.p: COFFEE - Firmer across board but off highs as NY finds new strength. July up $47 at $1,870 at 1438 GMT.
COCOA - Stronger than midsession but still tightly mixed. July struggles to break 1,000 stg. Unchanged at 995 stg.
SUGAR - Retains recent strength but volume light, ranges tight. August down 50 cents at $325.50, others mixed.
